---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an addition or improvement
labels: enhancement
---

## What problem would this solve?

Describe what you are trying to do, who needs it, and where the current
behavior falls short.

## What would you change?

Describe your proposed solution and any alternatives you have considered.

## Which part of Escalane would change?

- [ ] Alarm trigger / Yealink endpoint
- [ ] Acknowledgement link
- [ ] Admin UI or API
- [ ] Notification provider
- [ ] Escalation or worker job
- [ ] Database or migration
- [ ] Deployment or configuration
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other:

## What would operators need to know?

If you know, explain whether this would change alarm state, retries, queues,
notification delivery, authentication, sessions, or public endpoints. Mention
any expected migration, new setting, or change to operating procedures.

## How would we check that it works?

Suggest an example, test, or manual check that would demonstrate the improvement.

## Additional context

Include any useful examples or screenshots. Remove credentials, tokens,
acknowledgement URLs, personal alarm data, and internal hostnames.
